title: Woman Goes Nuts On Police After Punching A Cashier
description:
On April 16th, 2022, officers responded to a battery. The caller reported that a female had entered their business and asked for a lighter, but when the caller denied the request, the female hit her on the head. The woman was unwilling to give her personal information to the officers. Even after the officers' repeated explanations, the woman insisted on getting a lighter from the store. She was charged with battery on a peace officer, resisting arrest, and trespassing.
